jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Digital Payments & PCI-DSS
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of the digital payment ecosystem modernization, including the procurement and implementation of new acquiring and PSP services.
• Drive the compliance and certification efforts for the payment ecosystem, ensuring full adherence to regulatory standards.
• Orchestrate cross-functional teams across finance, legal, security, and architecture to consolidate complex business and technical requirements.
• Define the target architecture for payment flows and manage technical transitions between legacy and future service providers.
• Monitor project risks, dependencies, budgets, and timelines while providing strategic reporting to senior management.
• Direct the preparation of public procurement documents, technical specifications, and tender evaluations for large-scale IT and payment services.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in complex project management within regulated environments.
• You bring 3+ years of specialized expertise in electronic payments, including PSP, Acquiring, and monetics.
• You possess a proven track record in PCI-DSS compliance projects or comparable payment security initiatives.
• You're experienced in public procurement, including drafting RFP specifications and managing tender processes.
• You have advanced skills in budget management and risk and dependency management.
• You possess strong Supplier Relationship Management skills, particularly with IT and payment service providers.
• You have experience working within Agile frameworks and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with exceptional analytical and synthesis capabilities.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Certification in PRINCE2 Practitioner or Project Management Professional (PMP).
• Knowledge of Account Based Ticketing (ABT) or EMV payment systems.
• Experience in test management for payment solutions.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics

The hiring company is a multinational organization with a long-standing presence in the global market.

Jobomschrijving

• Oversee day-to-day IT operations, ensuring reliable infrastructure and support services.
• Manage and maintain server environments, network infrastructure, VPN connectivity, and security solutions.

With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience.

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset.

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

As a Catering Event Coordinator, you will play a key role in the success of our clients' events.
  
You will:
    
• Advise clients on catering and hospitality solutions for congresses, conferences and corporate events.  
• Coordinate catering projects from initial enquiry to on-site delivery.  
• Work closely with operational teams to ensure a seamless event experience.  
• Build lasting client relationships and contribute to customer satisfaction.  
• Help create memorable catering experiences for hundreds or even thousands of participants. 
  
• You hold at least a Bachelor's degree,  
• A first professional experience is an asset, but motivated graduates looking to build a career in the events and hospitality industry are also encouraged to apply.  
• You are organised and enjoy managing multiple projects simultaneously.  
• You communicate professionally and are customer-oriented.  
• You are eager to learn, proactive and willing to take initiative.  
• You enjoy teamwork and contribute to a positive working environment.      
Languages

Experience within the events, congress, hospitality or catering sector is a plus, but motivation, curiosity and a customer-focused mindset are just as important to us.

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3  years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Company Description

Our client is an international company operating in the real estate sector, located in the heart of Brussels. With a multicultural environment and several entities to manage, the company operates within an international structure and works closely with its parent company abroad. The finance team deals with multiple accounting standards and international reporting requirements.

Your Role

Working directly alongside the Chief Accountant, you will be responsible for the accounting of several entities and contribute to the preparation of financial information for both local and international reporting purposes. You will work with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, while also contributing to IFRS reporting.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage the general accounting of several entities.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, depending on the entity.
• Participate in monthly and annual closing procedures.
• Prepare the necessary adjustments for IFRS reporting.
• Perform account reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data.
• Contribute to reporting activities for the parent company.
• Work closely with the Chief Accountant and support the continuous improvement of accounting processes and internal controls.
• Collaborate with international finance teams to ensure consistent and reliable financial information.

Your Profile

• You have a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have solid experience in general accounting.
• You are familiar with Belgian GAAP and are willing to develop your knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and accounting software.
• You are rigorous, analytical and detail-oriented.
• A good command of English is an asset in this international environment.

Responsibilities

• Manage virtual teams across different departments to ensure continuous alignment between various stakeholders.
• Deliver business and technical projects on-time, on-scope, and on-budget using established project methodologies.
• Define project budgets, manage approvals through governance bodies, and monitor variances to prevent cost overruns.
• Develop realistic project plans and secure commitments from various departments regarding expected results.
• Identify risks pro-actively and initiate appropriate actions or escalations to mitigate potential issues.
• Provide continuous reporting on project status to management and offer day-to-day coaching to team members.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience as a dedicated Project Manager within complex, large-scale environments.
• You bring a proven track record in managing end-to-end business and technical projects involving IT development.
• You possess proficiency in project management methodologies including PMI, Prince 2, and Agile.
• You have experience using office and planning tools such as MS Project, Excel, Powerpoint, and Word.
• You're an autonomous and result-driven professional with strong leadership and conflict management skills.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with MS-Access.
• Ability to maintain composure and effectiveness in a continuously changing environment.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Drive business growth in the German market by identifying new opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing the full sales cycle. Commercial experience is a plus, not a must: motivated juniors with strong German and English skills are welcome to apply for this 100% on-site role in Antwerp.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

 

Omschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.
 

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

• Our client is an established property developer expanding its residential portfolio in Luxembourg, with a focus on well-designed, energy-efficient homes.
• Its local team combines an entrepreneurial working environment with the expertise and resources of a wider development group.
• Working closely with local management, you will have direct involvement in sales activity and the opportunity to contribute ideas that support commercial growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive sales across a portfolio of residential developments, advising both owner-occupiers and property investors.
• Understand buyers' priorities, budgets and investment objectives to recommend suitable properties.
• Convert enquiries into qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting, consistent follow-up and personalised advice.
• Lead property viewings, project presentations and sales meetings, guiding clients through the purchasing process.
• Build referral relationships with local agents, notaries, investors and other property professionals.
• Coordinate with marketing on lead generation, campaigns and events to support sales conversion.
• Monitor market trends, buyer demand and competing developments to identify commercial opportunities.
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline records and performance reporting.
• Depending on your experience and interests, contribute to partnerships and the identification of potential development acquisitions.

• At least three years of relevant real estate sales experience, preferably involving new-build residential property.
• A sound understanding of the Luxembourg property market; an existing local network would be an advantage.
• Excellent French and professional working proficiency in English. Luxembourgish, German or Dutch would be an asset.
• The ability to tailor your advice to both lifestyle-driven buyers and investment-focused clients.
• A proactive approach to prospecting, supported by commercial drive and disciplined follow-through.
• Professional communication, discretion and the ability to build trust throughout a significant purchasing decision.
• Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with management and marketing.
• An interest in developing your contribution beyond individual property transactions.
